newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania T-bill issue heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania T-bill issue heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday an issue of Finance Ministry fixed-interest treasury bills worth 611.27 billion lei was hevily oversubscribed this week.

It said a record 18 commercial banks, including foreign bank subsidiaries and branches and their corporate clients rushed to get the 91-day papers on Thursday, buying 1.444 trillion lei worth of T-bills.
The BNR said the ministry had accepted all bids.

The bills' annual yield is 193.22 percent or the three- month Bucharest Interbank Offered Rate set five working days ahead of the public subscription. This compared with short-term money market prices which hovered near 100 percent this week.
Three-month BUBOR was 189.13 percent on Thursday.
